items.question: What is Nowly?
items.answer: Nowly is a browser extension that automatically updates your Discord status (Rich Presence) with what you are watching on your favorite streaming platforms. It consists of a Chromium extension, a Windows native messaging host, and a website. The entire project is open source and free.

items.question: Is Nowly free?
items.answer: Yes, Nowly is completely free. The project is developed by two people in their spare time. If you wish to support the project, you can make a donation via Ko-fi, but this is entirely optional — all features are and will remain free.

items.question: How do I install Nowly?
items.answer:
Installation is a two-step process:
Step 1: install the extension from the Chrome Web Store.
Step 2: download and run the Windows installer (the native application that communicates with Discord).
Once both are installed, Nowly runs automatically in the background. No further configuration is needed.

items.question: Which platforms are supported?
items.answer:
Nowly currently supports YouTube, Twitch, Disney+, Apple TV+, and Prime Video.

New platforms are regularly added through extension updates. These presences are built by both the core team and community contributors. Anyone can propose or create a new presence — check the GitHub repository to get involved.

Head over to the library for the full list and the development status of each presence.

items.question: How does the Discord connection work?
items.answer: The native application communicates directly with the Discord client on your computer via a Windows named pipe (IPC). No data passes through our servers. Nowly simply sends your current activity information (title, platform, duration) to Discord, which displays it on your profile.

items.question: Are my data shared with third-party servers?
items.answer: No. Everything is processed locally on your machine. The extension detects content in your browser and passes it to the native application, which sends it directly to Discord via local communication. None of your personal data or activity is sent to our servers. Only aggregated statistics (installation count, rating) are stored for each presence.

items.question: Why is my Discord status not updating?
items.answer:
Several possible reasons:
  • Is Discord running on your computer?
  • Is the Nowly native application installed and running?
  • Is the extension enabled in your browser?
  • Is the presence for your platform installed from the library?


You can also open the extension's side panel to view debug messages.

items.question: How do I uninstall Nowly?
items.answer: To uninstall the extension, right-click the Nowly icon in your browser and select 'Remove from Chrome'. To uninstall the native application, run the uninstaller program available in the installation folder or use the Windows Control Panel.

items.question: Is Nowly open source?
items.answer: Yes, the complete source code of Nowly is available on GitHub. You can browse the code, suggest improvements, report bugs, or contribute to the project's development.

AboutPage.title: A modern take on Discord activity
AboutPage.intro: Nowly builds on the idea behind community Rich Presence tools and pushes it further: a cleaner, more current experience that is easier to use and shaped by a coherent visual direction.

sections.title: Our goal
sections.body: We are building a lightweight, open, and understandable alternative for syncing streaming platforms with Discord Rich Presence.

sections.title: A local-first approach
sections.body: The local flow stays constant: your browser detects activity, the native app sends it to Discord, without going through our servers*.

sections.title: A community project
sections.body: Nowly is open source. The presence library can grow through feedback, ideas, and contributions from the community.

sections.title: What we want to improve
sections.body: We are progressively adding new platforms, a smoother installation experience, and simpler tools for creating reliable presences.

AboutPage.analyticsNote: * Except optional analytics, which can be disabled during installation. They only measure aggregated information such as installs, with no name, email, or personal data that could identify you.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: Nowly is designed with your privacy as a priority. The application runs almost entirely locally on your machine — no personal data about you is collected, stored, or shared with our servers. This policy explains what information is processed, where, and why.

sections.title: General Operation
sections.body: Nowly consists of three parts: a browser extension, a Windows native application, and a website (marketplace). The extension detects media content in your browser and passes it to the native app, which sends it directly to the Discord client on your machine via a local Windows named pipe (IPC). None of this data ever touches our servers.

sections.title: Data Processed by the Extension
sections.body:
The browser extension stores the following data locally in chrome.storage.local — it never leaves your machine:
  • Installed presences (metadata, signed bundles, activation state).
  • Current activity (content title, platform, duration, thumbnail).
  • A debug log (timestamps, actions, visited URLs).
  • Onboarding state and a local snapshot of your Discord profile (ID, username, avatar) used solely for UI display.
  • Display preferences and per-presence settings.


This data stays on your device and can be erased by uninstalling the extension or by using the reset option in the extension settings.

sections.title: Data Processed by the Native Application
sections.body: The native Nowly application writes a log file to %LOCALAPPDATA%\NowlyClient\nowly-host.log containing timestamps and activity information sent to Discord. This file is stored locally, can be deleted at any time, and is never sent to our servers.

sections.title: Data Collected by the Website
sections.body:
The Nowly website uses Vercel Analytics for anonymous audience measurement. No third-party cookies, cross-site trackers, or profiling tools are used. Collected data is limited to:
  • Pages visited and visit duration.
  • Device type and browser (non-identifying information).
  • Approximate country (inferred from IP, which is not stored).


No personally identifiable information is collected through the website.

sections.title: Presence Statistics (Redis)
sections.body:
A Redis database (hosted on Upstash) stores aggregated, anonymous statistics for each presence:
  • Total installation count.
  • Active user count.
  • Average rating (rating sum and vote count).
  • Current version, creation date, and last update date.


These statistics cannot identify any individual user. They exist solely to inform you about each presence's popularity and status.

sections.title: Discord Communication
sections.body:
Nowly communicates with the Discord client via a local IPC interface. The following information may be transmitted to Discord solely for displaying your Rich Presence:
  • The platform name (e.g. YouTube).
  • The content title you are watching.
  • The channel or author name.
  • Playback state (playing / paused).
  • Duration and elapsed time.


This information is visible to anyone who can see your Discord profile. Nowly has no control over how Discord processes this data once received. Please refer to Discord's Privacy Policy for more details.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.body:
Nowly uses the following third-party services:
  • Vercel — website hosting and anonymous analytics.
  • Upstash — Redis database hosting (aggregated statistics).
  • Chrome Web Store — browser extension distribution.
  • Ko-fi — donation platform (no personal data is shared with Ko-fi by Nowly).
  • Discord — Rich Presence display (local communication only).

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: The Nowly website does not use any cookies for tracking or profiling purposes. No third-party cookies are set. Language preference is preserved through Next.js routing (no persistent cookies).

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Presence packages are cryptographically signed (ECDSA P-256) before distribution. The extension verifies the signature before installing or running any presence, ensuring only authorized code executes on your machine.

sections.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
sections.body: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your personal data. Since no personal data is collected on our servers, these rights are exercised locally by uninstalling the extension or deleting the native application log files.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out via the GitHub repository or on Ko-fi.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By downloading, installing, or using Nowly (the browser extension, native application, website, and any associated software), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the software.

sections.title: Service Description
sections.body:
Nowly is an open-source tool that detects media content in your browser and automatically updates your Discord status (Rich Presence) via local communication with the Discord client. The service consists of:
  • A Chromium browser extension that detects and reports your activity.
  • A Windows native application that acts as a gateway to Discord.
  • A website (marketplace) for discovering and installing presences.
  • A developer SDK and tooling for creating custom presences.

sections.title: License
sections.body: Nowly is distributed as open-source software. You are permitted to use, copy, modify, and redistribute it in accordance with the applicable license (available in the GitHub repository). This license does not apply to content from third-party platforms (YouTube, Twitch, etc.) that you choose to display via Nowly.

sections.title: Responsible Use
sections.body:
You agree to use Nowly in compliance with applicable laws and Discord's Terms of Service. Specifically, you must not:
  • Use Nowly to display illegal, hateful, or inappropriate content.
  • Attempt to bypass the security mechanisms of the extension or native application.
  • Distribute modified or unsigned presences through the official infrastructure.
  • Use Nowly in a way that violates the terms of service of Discord or any streaming platform you access.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.body: The Nowly source code is subject to its applicable open-source license. All third-party trademarks, logos, and platform names (YouTube, Twitch, Disney+, Apple TV+, Prime Video, Discord) remain the property of their respective owners. Nowly is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Discord Inc. or any of the supported streaming platforms.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.body:
Nowly is provided "as is", without any warranty, express or implied. The author shall not be held liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use or inability to use the software, including but not limited to:
  • Malfunction of Discord or your status display.
  • Suspension or restriction of your Discord account by Discord Inc.
  • Loss of data stored locally by the extension.
  • Any indirect damage related to the use of the native application.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.body: Your use of Nowly is governed by our Privacy Policy, which is incorporated into these Terms of Service. We encourage you to read it carefully before using the service.

sections.title: Changes to Terms
